headline: I design products 0-1

posts.text:
Should designers write product docs? Isn’t that Product Manager’s job?

AI pushed the boundaries of what a designer does. Desining UI have become easier than ever, but as designers we bring something far more valuable: context.

With that context, we can write PRDs, add a pinch of technical thinking, and align devs before we design UI.

As a design consultant, I keep it to a one-pager, as my devs don’t read long docs 😅

1. Context
2. Proposed solution
3. Priorities for phase one
4. Technical note : data flow, DB structure, etc., if you’re comfortable with them

Use AI, keep it real short. After everyone agrees on this one-pager, design UI
It has saved me so much back & forth and helped devs move faster.

Sharing the thinking behind the financial model we recently designed at OptiMotion, an EV subscription platform. This three-layer model brings consistency to financial transactions across all teams. 

Curious to hear your thoughts :)
